fact: The NBS quarterly Foreign Trade in Goods Statistics report for Q2 2025 (report date September 2025) states its trade statistics are compiled from secondary sources: Nigeria Customs Service declarations via NICIS, plus NNPCL, NMDPRA, the Central Bank of Nigeria, NEPZA, OGFZA, NERC, FAAN, NCAA and the Nigerian Ports Authority; the series is quarterly, with Q1 2025 and Q3 2024 editions also issued.
title: Foreign Trade in Goods Statistics (Q2 2025)
